title: “It’s A Viper’s Nest”: Insiders Explain BTS Toxic Drama Following Savannah Guthrie’s TODAY Return
desc: While Savannah Guthrie's emotional return to the TODAY show studio on March 5 was framed as a powerful moment of unity, behind-the-scenes drama was far less harmonious. On-screen, viewers saw captured hugs, prayers, and tearful exchanges as colleagues welcomed the veteran anchor back after weeks of personal turmoil. However, insiders alleged the atmosphere inside NBC's morning program exposed intense rivalries and opportunistic manoeuvring among staff.
